attrs.summary: Ling-3.0-flash-Fin is the first finance-enhanced model in the Ant Ling family. Developed by Ant Group with leading financial institutions and domain experts, it extends Ling-3.0-flash through continued training on high-quality financial data. With 124B total parameters, 5.1B activated parameters, and a 256K context window, the model combines financial expertise with efficient inference for long-horizon agent workflows.
